tags.title: Spans whose parent span is missing
tags.concept: Anti-join (LEFT JOIN ... WHERE right side IS NULL)
tags.question: Which traces contain spans pointing to a parent that never arrived (or was quarantined)?
tags.interpretation: Orphans break the trace waterfall. Causes: corrupted parent IDs, or a parent event that was quarantined as structurally invalid (check dead_letter_events for the same trace).
